name: Ice Breath
doc: Ice Breath (the Snow Lion's attack; the Cronos mod's item Arctic Wind): the root and the director - the caster's mouth blowing a frost swirl, a glow and breath cones, then frost puffs and spinning crystal layouts along a sweep toward the targets, an ice trail on the floor that grows and shatters into flying triangles, ice shards round the midpoint, the screen flash, the sounds; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag173_ice_breath.cpp) run on the program's memory (its particle table, polygon states and queues in the module, its crystal players and packets in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: The timeline: when each part starts, the mouth anchor (the caster's bone 0xF0 and an offset, retaken every tick), the screen flash in and out, the sounds; the damage

parts.title: Mouth swirl
parts.doc: Frost sprites swirling about the caster's mouth: a few a tick, each on a random axis, its radius shrinking as it spins; cleared at its end

parts.title: Breath cones
parts.doc: Cone models blown from the mouth along the caster's facing, each after its delay and turned on its z axis, shrinking, fading at their end

parts.title: Mouth glow
parts.doc: A glow model at the mouth facing the camera, growing (faster from a tick), fading at its end

parts.title: Breath puffs
parts.doc: Frost puffs blown from the mouth along a sweep of the way to the targets, growing, slowing, falling to a floor, coloured by frame

parts.title: Crystals
parts.doc: Crystal layouts (prim-model players) placed along a sweep of the breath, one a tick, each spun and scaled at random

parts.title: Ice trail
parts.doc: Five ice meshes on the floor from the caster toward the targets: their triangles appear outward, then fly apart spinning and darkening

parts.title: Ice shards
parts.doc: Shard sprites around the midpoint flying away from the mouth, stretched along their way

groups.label: Screen flash
groups.doc: Its colour, up to a tick its level rising by a step, from a tick falling by a step to the director's end

params.label: Start
params.doc: At the director's tick 1

params.label: Blast
params.doc: At the director's blast tick

params.label: Swirl tick
params.doc: The mouth swirl starts at this tick of the director

params.label: Glow tick
params.doc: The mouth glow starts at this tick

params.label: Cones tick
params.doc: The breath cones start at this tick (at the mouth of then)

params.label: Puffs tick
params.doc: The breath puffs start at this tick

params.label: Crystals tick
params.doc: The crystal spawner starts at this tick (from 1: their pool is made at tick 1)

params.label: Trail tick
params.doc: The ice trail starts at this tick (at the mouth of then, turned away from the caster's facing)

params.label: Shards tick
params.doc: The ice shards start at this tick (flying away from the mouth of then)

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The damage (every target of the action) at this tick

params.label: Blast tick
params.doc: The blast sound at this tick

params.label: End tick
params.doc: The director's last tick (the screen flash fades out toward it; the effect ends once every part has)

params.label: Mouth offset
params.doc: The mouth: this far along the caster's facing (its z, negative = ahead) from its bone 0xF0

params.label: On the targets
params.doc: 0: everything starts at the caster's mouth (the game). 1: at the targets instead, nothing launched from the caster - the anchor is their centre moved by the next values (a new effect's choice)

params.label: Targets: sideways
params.doc: On the targets: the anchor this far sideways of their centre (the caster's x)

params.label: Targets: height
params.doc: On the targets: the anchor's height (y, negative = up; the floor is 0)

params.label: Targets: before them
params.doc: On the targets: the anchor this far before their centre, toward the caster (the way it blows is from there to the centre and on; at least 1)

params.label: Colour
params.doc: The screen flash's colour (0xBBGGRR)

params.label: Rise until
params.doc: The flash level rises up to this tick

params.label: Rise step
params.doc: Its level: the tick x this (4096 = full)

params.label: Fall from
params.doc: From this tick the level falls

params.label: Fall step
params.doc: Its level: (the end tick - the tick) x this

params.label: Last spawn tick
params.doc: Sprites spawn from its tick 0 to this one

params.label: A tick
params.doc: How many spawn a tick (100 particles at most, shared with the puffs and the shards)

params.label: End tick
params.doc: At this tick of its own the swirl ends (its sprites cleared)

params.label: Size
params.doc: A sprite's size: this + a random below the next

params.label: Size random
params.doc: (at least 1)

params.label: Radius
params.doc: Its distance from the mouth: this + a random below the next

params.label: Radius random
params.doc: (at least 1)

params.label: Shrink divisor
params.doc: Its radius shrinks a tick by the radius / (this + a random below the next)

params.label: Shrink random
params.doc: (at least 1)

params.label: Spin
params.doc: Its angle about its axis a tick: this + a random below the next

params.label: Spin random
params.doc: (at least 1)

params.label: Count
params.doc: How many cones (their delays and z angles: the tables, 4 at most)

params.label: Size
params.doc: A cone's starting size (4096 = its model's)

params.label: Shrink
params.doc: Its size shrinks a tick by this (which loses 1/20 a tick)

params.label: Fade from
params.doc: From this tick of its own it fades (1024 a tick)

params.label: Life
params.doc: A cone ends at this tick of its own (after its delay)

params.label: Size
params.doc: The glow's starting size (4096 = its model's)

params.label: Growth
params.doc: Its size grows a tick by this

params.label: Faster from
params.doc: From this tick of its own the growth speeds up ((growth + 32) x 4 / 3 a tick)

params.label: Fade from
params.doc: From this tick of its own it fades (1024 a tick)

params.label: Life
params.doc: The glow ends at this tick of its own

params.label: Last spawn tick
params.doc: Puffs spawn from its tick 0 to this one

params.label: A tick
params.doc: How many spawn a tick (100 particles at most, shared)

params.label: Size
params.doc: A puff's size: this + a random below the next (it grows 1/16 a tick)

params.label: Size random
params.doc: (at least 1)

params.label: Spread
params.doc: Where it starts: the mouth + a random below this (x, z: centred; y: minus 4 a tick of its own)

params.label: Speed
params.doc: Its speed along the swept way: this + a random below the next (losing 1/32 a tick)

params.label: Speed random
params.doc: (at least 1)

params.label: Fall random
params.doc: Its downward speed: a random below this (+ the way's)

params.label: Sweep start
params.doc: The way to the targets turned about y by this at its tick 0

params.label: Sweep step
params.doc: and by this more each tick

params.label: Floor
params.doc: A puff moves up or down only while above this height (y, negative = up)

params.label: Ahead
params.doc: Where they start: this far from the anchor along the way to the targets (0: at the anchor, the game; a new effect on the targets: onto them)

params.label: Depth
params.doc: Their spread along z, for the spread's (4096 = the same as x and y, the game; less: a thinner cloud toward the caster)

params.label: Last spawn tick
params.doc: One crystal a tick from its tick 0 to this one

params.label: Sweep start
params.doc: The swept breath way turned about y by this at its tick 0

params.label: Sweep step
params.doc: and by this more each tick

params.label: Distance
params.doc: How far along it: (this + a random below the next) x twice the mouth-to-midpoint length / 4096

params.label: Distance random
params.doc: (at least 1)

params.label: Offset
params.doc: Moved by a random below this on each axis (centred)

params.label: Spin random
params.doc: Its z spin a frame: a random below this

params.label: Scale
params.doc: Its scale: this + a random below the next (4096 = the layout's)

params.label: Scale random
params.doc: (at least 1)

params.label: Size
params.doc: The meshes' scale (4096 = theirs)

params.label: Appear ticks
params.doc: Its triangles appear for this many ticks (each by its distance), then fly apart

params.label: All shown at
params.doc: While appearing, from this tick every triangle is shown

params.label: Speed
params.doc: A flying triangle's speed outward: this + a random below the next (losing 1/16 a tick)

params.label: Speed random
params.doc: (at least 1)

params.label: Last spawn tick
params.doc: Shards spawn from its tick 0 to this one

params.label: A tick
params.doc: How many spawn a tick (100 particles at most, shared)

params.label: Size
params.doc: A shard's size: this + a random below the next

params.label: Size random
params.doc: (at least 1)

params.label: Spread x

params.label: Spread z
params.doc: and below this on z (centred)

params.label: Speed
params.doc: Its speed away from the mouth: this + a random below the next

params.label: Speed random

params.label: Swirl
params.doc: The sprite sequence swirl (a flipbook of 24 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Puff

params.label: Shard
params.doc: The sprite sequence shard (a flipbook of 16 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Crystal
params.doc: The prim-model layout crystal (its models' animation)

params.label: Cone model
params.doc: The prim model cone (a mesh of 73 vertices, 72 primitives: an edited one keeps at least as many vertices)

params.label: Glow model
params.doc: The prim model glow (a mesh of 33 vertices, 32 primitives: an edited one keeps at least as many vertices)

params.label: Cone delays
params.doc: Each breath cone's delay (ticks before it shows and starts its clock) (16 bytes: an edited one keeps its length)

params.label: Cone z angles

params.label: Puff colours
params.doc: A breath puff's colour words by its frame (red, green, blue, the GPU code byte) (64 bytes: an edited one keeps its length)

params.label: Crystal flags
params.doc: The crystal layout's object flag word (0x10000000: its position through the camera; its draw flags, the semi-transparency bit forced on) (4 bytes: an edited one keeps its length)

params.label: Texture file
params.doc: The texture file its loader reads from the magic folder (a name of at most 31 letters)

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)
